description: Fuzzy keyword search across standalone components, design-system components, AND ready-made templates (whole example screens). Matches on slug, name, description, categories, and tags; returns best matches ranked by relevance. Use when the user describes what they want in their own words, e.g. "an animated card stack", "background with waves", "a mission control dashboard". Results include screenshot URLs and install commands for immediate evaluation. A result tagged `"kind": "template"` is a full screen. Fetch it with `get_template`, not `get_component`.

limit.description: Max number of matches to return. Default 10.

query.description: Free-text search query. Multiple words are tokenized and matched independently.

name: search_components
title: Search AI Canvas components
